title: Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda to Amazon EventBridge
description: Make a request to API Gateway that sends an event to EventBridge via Lambda.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern creates an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API, a AWS Lambda function (publisher), a custom EventBridge bus and event rule, and another Lambda function (subscriber) using SAM and Java 25.
This example is an implementation of an publisher/subscriber pattern in Event-Drivent Architecture.
